title: Explore promoter cofactors: from TA/DN associations to a saved motif region

catalog.notes: Offline synthetic promoter-cofactor package walkthrough, starting with an empty project and no genome installed. Inspect DuckDB/Parquet coverage; compare TA/DN adjusted odds ratios, uncertainty, BH q and positive/eligible anchor frequency in six distance bands. Inspect strongest TP73-associated motif hits, raw log2-relative-risk scores, strand, promoter ownership and separate sample/control summaries. Explain source floor -1 versus presence threshold 0, missing versus zero, overview-only motifs and unchanged cohort statistics. Save report-bound evidence through regions capture, inspect genomic regions, and preview/explicitly approve stranded motif features against exact locally prepared synthetic DNA. Keep unstranded evidence as regions; never reconstruct coverage or claim occupancy. Copy the displayed request through CLI/MCP without stale-form drift. Optional local IRF9 example found by GRCh38 coordinates, not anchor ID. Replay: scripts/promoter_cofactor_tutorial.py; ui open tutorial-guide promoter_cofactor_browser. codex source review 2026-09-16: wet-lab readability and reproducibility; native GUI and human scientific approval pending.
